newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Philippines to sell April 380 centistoke fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Philippines to sell April 380 centistoke fuel oil.

text.p: Philippines oil refiner Petron Corp has issued a tender to sell 200,000 to 250,000 barrels of April 3.5 percent sulphur fuel oil, a company official said on Thursday.
The tender sought a 380 centistoke or maximum 450 centistoke fuel oil for loading April 1-5 from Bataan.
The tender closes March 21 and is valid on the same day.
The official did not provide any details on why the refiner has barrels for sale as it seldom exports fuel oil
